selection_policy.products: The ten story-rich pilot products are included before scaling the same workflow across full-corpus proof shells.
selection_policy.private_capture_policy: Write captures, crops, OCR JSON, and image-map paths only under the private OCR run directory.
selection_policy.public_output_policy: Public artifacts contain source URLs, action labels, hashes/statuses, and candidate-only OCR status. They do not contain private paths or reproduced external photos.
